# AddMyID

> AddMyID is an independent reference site that helps US residents add their state digital ID, mobile driver's license (mDL), or US passport to Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, or Samsung Wallet.

## About

AddMyID covers all 50 US states and territories, tracking which states have launched digital ID programs (mDL — mobile driver's license, ISO 18013-5 standard). Each state page lists supported phone wallets, step-by-step setup instructions, and a link to the official state program page.

As of 2026, 21 US states and territories have live digital ID programs: Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Iowa, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Montana, New Mexico, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Puerto Rico, Utah, Virginia, and West Virginia.

## Wallet guides

- [Apple Wallet guide](https://addmyid.info/guides/apple): Step-by-step instructions for adding a state digital ID or US passport to Apple Wallet on iPhone (iOS 15.4+). Participating states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Iowa, Maryland, Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Puerto Rico, West Virginia.
- [Google Wallet guide](https://addmyid.info/guides/google): Step-by-step instructions for adding a state digital ID or US passport to Google Wallet on Android (Android 9+). Participating states: Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, Puerto Rico.
- [Samsung Wallet guide](https://addmyid.info/guides/samsung): Step-by-step instructions for adding a state digital ID to Samsung Wallet on Galaxy phones (One UI 5+). Participating states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, West Virginia.
